notes.title: Version 1.2.4
notes.content:
Ver. 1.2.4
Fixed drops and visuals lingering from the DOTO Anniversary.

notes.title: Version 1.2.3
notes.content:
Ver. 1.2.3
Fixed the missing icon for "Useless Bauble".
Fixed missing UI for the event calendar.
Fixed the Single Target Attack Bonus from "Ephemeral Orb" being applied much higher then intended.
Fixed errors in spelling when the player levels Paragon.
Fixed rounding errors for champion equipment.

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.content:
Ver. 1.2.2
Fixed issues with the event calendar showing the wrong text.
Fixed an issue where the event item was unable to drop from bosses.
Fixed an issue where the blacksmith would not update UI and play audio when crafting equipment.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Ver. 1.2.1
Celebrate 1 year of DOTO with a month of rewards and boosted Moon-Soom buffs.

Starting April 1st and going throughout the month Illune will offer a calendar of rewards. Rewards include buffs, energy/astrolabes, upgrade materials and a powerful new offhand focus "Ephemeral Orb".
From 3/28-5/1 the daily Moon-Soom effect is doubled.
Use the new code "ONEYEAR" for a collecting of extra loot.
New offhand focus: "Ephemeral Orb" this event exclusive item will be added to the loot pool during the event month from 4/1-5/1 and grants a new effect "Increased damage from single target attacks."

New consumable: "Useless Bauble" grants a tiny 1% boost to all Non-Combat Traits for 31 days and is an incredibly rare drop from high difficulty Dungeons and Breaches.

Fixes & Polish
Improved the way loot can be generated to improve load times.
Made improvements to the Shop and Jeweler to prevent crashes.
Made improvements to how the wardrobe saves and stores information.
Added features to Paragon to give rewards for certain tiers.

notes.title: Version 1.1.9.01
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.9.01
Fixed loot tables for challenges showing the incorrect or missing items.
Fixed the minor stat "Mana Cost Reduction" not correctly applying to auto-mode.
Fixed an issue where the "Crimson Boots" would appear behind the player model.
Updated backend to clear out larger data piles from older players, changes will improve server load and prevent overloading it with redundant data.
Updated auto-mode to help encourage "All" attack type to be used in crowds.

notes.title: Version 1.1.81
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.81
Added new artifacts to the wardrobe.
Fixed issues with the leaderboards getting merged.
Improved functions for loading Challenge UI.

notes.title: Version 1.1.7
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.7
Updated the Support Consumable Pack with an increased amount of items.
XP Potions 5->20
Zap Energy Packs 10->35
Astro Packs 4->10
Counterpart Tokens 10->200
Vestige Powder 10->200
--This change will affect any packs that were purchased but not used along with all future packs.

Fixed issues with the Challenge selection UI that would show incorrect Challenge details.

notes.title: Version 1.1.6
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.6
Fixed the new champion leg armor not appearing in the wardrobe.
Fixed recipes at the blacksmith not getting locked when a player has not used the correct recipe consumable.
Fixed text errors causing certain companions to show battle text buffs twice.
Fixed an error that could cause the wrong boss to appear in challenges.
Fixed an error causing the wrong item to drop from the rat challenge boss.

notes.title: Version 1.1.12
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.12
Fixed various visuals in town.
Fixed loot issues where players could get a non-existent legendary to drop and cause freezing or crashing.

notes.title: Version 1.1.091
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.091
Fixed various issues with UI elements.

notes.title: Version 1.1.09
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.09
Fixed various issues related to recent UI changes.
Fixed issues with creating new characters.
Fixed UI stutter in dungeon environments.
Fixed layering issues that would cause certain elements to be hidden.

notes.title: Ver. 1.1.08
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.08
Fixed various UI issues preventing interaction with certain game mechanics.
Fixed various UI issues causing animated UI elements to become hidden.

Added a gift package in the mail to players affected by recent errors and crashes.

notes.title: Versions 1.1.07
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.07
Event: Meteor Showers!
Starting from September 17th to September 30th the Meteor Showers! event is active, Quilwen is offering discounted Baby Bar-Soom's and Bar-Soom bundles in the Emporium. additionally use the code "STARSHOWER" for a bundle of items. 

Updated UI systems to reduce the strain and load they were causing on PCs.
Fixed issues that would cause the shop or jeweler menu's to crash the game when opened.

notes.title: Version 1.1.05
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.05
Fixed an issue where curio material purchases would not give items.
Fixed an issue where the crafting menu would show champion materials in chat.
Fixed an issue where the buff text details on the information panel would block other UI.
Fixed an issue where the blacksmith would not ask for confirmation when scrapping champion items in some cases.
improved text for astro-packs offered by the jeweler.

notes.title: Version 1.1.04
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.04
Fixed an issue where champion items would not unlock in the wardrobe.
Fixed an issue where purchases in the shop could cause the purchase to be replaced with crystals instead of the original item.

notes.title: Version 1.1.03
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.03
Fixed an issue where loading into a challenge would default auto-mode to off.
Fixed an issue where the shop would show consumable item tooltips incorrectly.

notes.title: Version 1.1.02
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.02
Added a challenges cleared statistic to the information menu.
Recipes will now appear in chat when dropped.
The Jeweler Astro-Pack offers now have updated text for clarity.
Fixed a text error that would show the "Emperor's New Clothes" priced as $24.99 instead of $14.99.
Fixed the arms on the "explorer shirt" armor variant being off center.

notes.title: Version 1.1.01
notes.content:
Ver. 1.1.01

Rerun challenges now correctly checks for energy.
Enemies in challenges can now drop Morbid Gasps.
Fixed the challenge leaderboard to no longer squish text.
Fixed an issue where artifacts could have stat boosts applied twice.
Added new checks for getting the jester to appear in town.
Updated the curios UI for improved clarity and to show new bonuses given by companions.
Updated various UI.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.95
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.95
The monster Koruzuran within the Breach seems to have undergone a change, almost as if anticipating a Challenge fast approaching. The equipment taken from it's body has become more powerful and as such can grant greater benefits to those who wear it.
A new Artifact is available in the shop,  known as "Wolf's Boon" it is able to grant Dexterity from player level, 15% Area Damage and 15% Double Attack to those blessed by it's power.

Fixed an issue where the Monster Index would show incorrect enemy visuals.
Updated various text elements for clarity.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.94
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.94
Fixed an issue where enemies would use the wrong visuals when viewing them in combat.
Fixed issues where the players mana regen stat could drop below 10%.
Glimmer now cycle it's colors in combat to show the active buff.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.93
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.93
Added the new companion "Glimmer", this companion can provide up to 30% Strength, Dexterity, Health Regenerate or Mana Regenerate with a buff that cycles every turn. 
Fixed the blinking issue when closing the game (3rd times the charm).
Fixed issues with the consumable (Zap Pack) where it would not function and had an incorrect icon.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.92
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.92
Fixed issues that could cause rapid blinking when trying to close the game.
Fixed an issue where the bulletin board would not prevent the inventory from opening with the "I" keybind.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.91
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.91
Fixed an issue where artifacts and companions might not unlock in the wardrobe. (Players who experienced this issue can email support to have them correctly added to the wardrobe.)
Improved the save system so that closing the game will no longer cause some players to have certain changes not get saved correctly.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.9
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.9
Added the new artifact "Monument of Thruhah" to the shop, this artifact provides up to 25 Strength per player level and 30% Damage to Elites.
Updated the inventory UI so player stats and info are in front of animated elements such as artifacts.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.83
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.83
Added the new companion "Trinity" to the shop, this companion gives up to a 45% chance to prevent death while also healing for 5% max health.
Fixed UI errors on the energy trackers that caused default text to appear in dungeons.
Fixed backend errors with how the system handled set items.
Fixed errors that could cause the boss battle to be skipped in dungeons.
Added new methods to the server to help prevent players from getting stuck in town.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.81
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.81
Fixed an error where the new yellow elite icon was being used on rare mobs, rare mobs now use the red icon while legendary mobs use the yellow icon.
Made improvements towards the in-game energy timer system.
Improved the animator system for the fish companion to prevent errors.
Improved the loot generation system for efficiency.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.8
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.8
[b]Shop update[/b]
Items in shop that cost crystals now ask for confirmation before a purchase is made.
Curios tab has been reworked and no longer shows 2 curios at a time, smaller tabs allow users to view all currently added curios. 
Uncommon consumables such as the "Metal Detector" now have a new UI menu to allow purchases of 1x, 10x and 50x instead of being purchased 1 at a time.

Changed elite icons to use a new yellow color palette.
Changed some text on the dungeon selection UI to prevent UI from falling off at high values.
Prepping backend for future changes to the loot system.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.71
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.71
Fixed inaccurate text for consumables in the shop.
Fixed UI issues on some consumables causing the flavor text to fall off the UI.
Fixed issues where enemy info panel could be opened when the enemy died.
Updated some UI to no longer fall off panels at high values.
Updated potion UI to have visual differences for mouse hover and for pressing it.
Changed the priority of hiding certain UI to help ensure other features work correctly.
Finalized save system changes to ensure all load functions have proper default values and cannot give errors that would freeze/break/crash systems.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.7
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.7
Added the new artifact "Pendant of Void" that can provide up to 25 Dexterity per player level along with up to 10% Dodge Chance. (This will replace the "Mask of Taku-Ra" in the shop for a time until an upcoming shop update to improve the curios tab.)
Fixed an issue where profile could not calculate legendary artifact stat bonuses.
Fixed an issue where beating a dungeon could cause the screen to show the loot reward and return to town menus at the same time.
Fixed issues where Astrolabes would not track time progressed correctly while a player was logged in.
Added a time tracker while in town to Astrolabes, the tracker is viewed when the cursor hovers over the Astrolabes on the top of the UI.
Updated the paragon UI menu so it no longer falls off it's boundary.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.61
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.61
Fixed issues on the main menu where the UI to enter the game would be blocked.
Improved UI features to ensure they hide instead of blocking the screen.
Changed the sewer boss pathing to prevent scenarios where the player would linger while the boss wandered away.
Changed UI orientation of the close game menu on the main menu to be in-front of other UI elements.
Updated text on the blacksmith imbue for clarity.
Improving backend load systems to prevent scenarios of load errors.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.6
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.6
Improved backend systems to have better save file loading.
Fixed and issue where the Fishy companion was missing from the wardrobe, any player who owns the companion and is missing the wardrobe item should contact the support email.
Fixed various backend errors the could cause issues when the game was processing currency.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.52
notes.content:
Fixed an error where users who had a dungeon lockout bug would be stuck on dungeon level 10.
All players will receive a gift in the mail as compensation for the bug.

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.content: Fixed some dungeon issues that could cause players to either be unable to load dungeons or load into dungeons at rank 10 regardless of settings.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.5
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.5
Fixed an issue where enemies would prevent the escape dungeon option from working in combat.
Fixed an issue where pronouns would always default to They/Them.
Fixed some network errors the would force players to load to town without connecting to a server.
Adjusted the body layer for armor to no longer be in front of the head.
Updated the load screen from main menu to town.
Shifted how the profile is read internally, players logging in will automatically shift the profile to read a save file instead of the Playfab inventory.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.4
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.4
Added the new companion "Thirsty" to the shop. This companion provides an up to 60% chance to increase your Area Damage Chance by 6% each time you land a single target attack. (Thirsty will be available in shop for a set time before entering a rotation with other companions)
Changed the main menu to show the EULA and Privacy Policy.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.2
notes.content:
Improved systems to prevent instances of consumables getting lost.
Improved systems to prevent instances where potions get locked during boss battles.
Changed how loading into town functions to prevent instances where the camera gets locked or a white player model would appear.
Fixed an issue where the game would black screen when being sent to the main menu while idle.

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.0
notes.content:
Fixed some instances where dungeon enemies would be to close to one another.
Fixed UI issues with consumables causing them to be bunched up.
Fixed an issue where the crystal pack was using the gray dust icon.
Changed the UI for when an item is to high a level, it now appears for a short time instead of having a close button.
